scope: FD-003. Release-build checks are distinguished from the user-accepted keyboard trial and the earlier native integration tests.

release_build.native: Versioned EXE, original and edited worksheet revisions, CR/CRLF, rejection of stale open/save messages, group restore, keyboard and panel height round trip.
release_build.native_and_browser: Editor startup, four example domains and pagination, clear and type, fraction and Tab, 31 Greek names, long-press selection and cancellation, preservation of raw and over-limit input, restore and manual copy fallback. Browser tests opened the HTML extracted from the portable ZIP via file://.
release_build.keyboard: Native 560-pixel window: four tabs, each 227 CSS pixels high. The five alphabetic rows, Shift and Backspace received clicks. Standalone Edge viewports 400, 560 and 1100: even tab heights, visible alphabetic key labels and five full rows.

release_archives.checks: Member bytes, CRC, allowlists, notices, HTML and standalone EXE binding. Extracted source rebuilds the same HTML offline and compiles Windows against the pinned SDK.

user_accepted_trial.verified_release_html_delta: Only the displayed version changes from 1.4.0 to 1.5.0.
user_accepted_trial.native_keyboard: 400 and 560 pixel wide windows at 100% scale. Five full alphabetic rows and four 227 CSS-pixel tabs, no change in native height on switching. User accepted the trial.

earlier_fd003_native_integration.window: Min/max/restore, pin, panel positions and work-area bounds at three real system scales. A minimum 400 logical px corresponded to 400 / 500 / 600 device px.
earlier_fd003_native_integration.instance_and_hotkey: Simultaneous launch, reactivation, hidden and minimized restore, foreground toggle, hotkey conflict between distinct portable directories.
earlier_fd003_native_integration.worksheet: Native file pickers, cancelled operations, invalid files, denied/confirmed overwrite and replacement, snapshot saved during concurrent editing, recovery and reopening after restart.
earlier_fd003_native_integration.clipboard: Both copy modes pasted verbatim into an independent Windows textbox. No clipboard data stored.

not_verified: Windows 10 and physical mixed-DPI multi-monitor movement or restore
Physical IME candidate UI (composition events tested)
Standalone Edge OS clipboard round trip, macOS/Linux/mobile browser interaction
Mathematical correctness or target application rendering
